editorial_note: Curated leads, not verified anomalous objects. Entries remain in the archive and are updated as new primary evidence arrives.

cases.title: Federal agents' black-triangle report
cases.summary: FBI interview and AARO memorandum describe a reported silent triangular object. Accounts differ in timing and sequence. The accompanying images were illustrations, not photographs.
cases.evidence: Declassified interview record and agency memorandum, not instrument measurements or authenticated object imagery.
questions: What explains the differences between the two official narratives?
Is there independent sensor evidence or unredacted chronology?
Which ordinary explanations can be tested with the released details?

cases.title: Rotating lights reported over Gillette, Wyoming
cases.summary: A Gillette resident shared video showing three lights appearing to rotate in a triangular pattern. A MUFON Wyoming investigator reviewed the footage and said he had no explanation at present.
cases.evidence: Witness testimony and reported video; no verified instrument or flight-track match in this case file.
questions: Can original footage and exact timestamps be obtained?
What were the camera direction, location and exposure settings?
Could aircraft, satellites, drones or atmospheric effects account for the pattern?
